name: dokan-playwright-tests
description: End-to-end and API test automation suite for Dokan plugin using Playwright

scripts._comment_installation_usage: Run these commands when setting up for the first time
scripts.create:admin: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {execSync} = require('child_process'); const user = process.env.ADMIN || 'shohan'; const pass = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || '01dokan01'; const email = process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL || 'shohan@wedevs.com'; console.log('🔧 Creating admin user:', user, '(' + email + ')'); try { const result = execSync('npm run wp-env run tests-cli -- wp user create ' + user + ' ' + email + ' --role=administrator --user_pass=' + pass + ' --porcelain', {encoding: 'utf8'}); const userId = result.trim().split('\n').pop().trim(); console.log('✅ Admin user created! ID:', userId); console.log('📧 Email:', email); console.log('👤 Username:', user); console.log('🔑 Password:', pass); console.log(''); console.log('ℹ️  Docker default admin (admin/password) still exists for fallback'); } catch(e) { if (e.message.includes('already exists')) { console.log('✅ User', user, 'already exists, updating password...'); try { execSync('npm run wp-env run tests-cli -- wp user update ' + user + ' --user_pass=' + pass + ' --skip-email', {stdio: 'inherit'}); console.log('✅ Admin password updated!'); console.log('👤 Username:', user); console.log('🔑 Password:', pass); console.log('📧 Email:', email); } catch(e2) { console.log('⚠️  Could not update user'); } } else { console.log('⚠️  Error:', e.message); } }"
scripts.docker:reset: npm run reset:db && npm run create:admin && npm run docker:setup
scripts.docker:full: npm run start:env && npm run create:admin && npm run docker:setup
scripts._comment_local_usage: For testing against existing WordPress installations
scripts.site:reset: NO_SETUP=false npm run site:setup && npm run env:setup
scripts._comment_test_modes_usage: Different ways to run and debug tests
scripts._comment_reporting_usage: View test results and generate reports
scripts._comment_verification_usage: Check WordPress state and debug issues
scripts.check:users: npm run wp-env run tests-cli -- wp user list
scripts.check:plugins: npm run wp-env run tests-cli -- wp plugin list --status=active
scripts.check:pages: npm run wp-env run tests-cli -- wp post list --post_type=page --fields=ID,post_title,post_status,post_author
scripts.check:modules: curl -s http://localhost:9999/?rest_route=/dokan/v1/admin/modules -u $(grep ADMIN= .env | cut -d= -f2):$(grep ADMIN_PASSWORD= .env | cut -d= -f2) | jq -r '.[] | select(.active == true) | .id' | wc -l | xargs echo 'Active modules:'
scripts._comment_utilities_usage: Code quality, type checking, and maintenance
scripts.restore:pages: npm run wp-env run tests-cli -- bash -c "wp post list --post_type=page --post_status=trash --format=ids | xargs -r -I {} wp post update {} --post_status=publish --post_author=2"
